body_html: The bridal party came in the room before we were even scheduled to start without warning and thus missed introductions. Moving forward through the night it seemed as though they had no idea what was going on so I told her I would just scratch the timeline and keep things moving in a good order – she was very happy with that and said that would be fine.”,”As one of the most experience DJs on the staff of JAMMIN’ DJs, it is very rare that I find a venue that I personally have not DJ’d a wedding at previously. However tonight I can say that changed when I worked at the American Mountaineering Museum in Golden. It’s always such a pleasure to be at a venue I haven’t seen before and this place was awesome! Between the rock climbing wall when you walk in and the incredible photos on the walls, definitely a place I’d love to be back at! This wedding was a full house with every chair taken. Once we got going with the dancing we had a full dance floor all night too! What a great wedding
